description:
Get weigh-ins from the local cache: weight (kg), BMI, body fat %, body water %, muscle and bone mass (kg), visceral fat, and where each came from (scale, manual, linked app). Includes the change over the period and the weight goal if one is set.

Only days with a weigh-in appear. Defaults to the last 365 days.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for complete structured data

name: garmin_get_body_composition
title: Weight and body composition
